fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Foot platoons provide the most basic garrison capability, assigned to secure HPG compounds and ComStar facilities on worlds where heavier forces are not available or not required. What they lack in mobility they compensate for with low logistical overhead and the ability to operate indefinitely in static defensive positions. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
